LightningComponentBundle.description: Time series confidence-interval / acceptable-range chart powered by D3.js — fills the band between a lower and upper bound, with an optional center line, and drill-down support.

property.name: dateField
property.label: Date Field
property.description: API name of the date/datetime field for X-axis

property.name: lowerField
property.label: Lower Bound Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field holding the band's lower bound

property.name: upperField
property.label: Upper Bound Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field holding the band's upper bound

property.name: valueField
property.label: Center Line Field
property.description: Optional numeric field drawn as a center line within the band

property.name: dateFormat
property.label: Date Format
property.description: Date format for parsing: ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), US (MM/DD/YYYY), EU (DD/MM/YYYY)

property.name: curveType
property.label: Curve Style
property.description: Area curve interpolation style

property.name: height
property.label: Height (px)
property.description: Chart height in pixels

property.name: theme
property.label: Color Theme
property.description: Color palette for the chart

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object to query. When set (and no records are passed in), the chart self-fetches this object via GraphQL. Also used for drill-down navigation on band/point click.

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Date Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to process. Leave empty for default.

property.name: graphqlQuery
property.label: GraphQL Query
property.description: Optional override of the built query. Must be a UI API record query (uiapi.query) whose node selects the Date Field, Lower Bound Field, Upper Bound Field, and (if set) Center Line Field as top-level fields; the returned rows are shaped into the band client-side. UI-API-queryable objects only; at most 2,000 records; GraphQL syntax. Footgun: if a bound field is missing from the query it reads as 0 and the band flattens rather than erroring; if the Date Field is missing every row is dropped. Leave blank to build the query automatically.

property.name: advancedConfig
property.label: Advanced Config (JSON)
property.description: {"showGrid": true, "customColors": ["#1589EE"]}
